# goslop text fixture — soft recording into warnings list retains the failure
# on the result (Project_Parva rulelang evidence-packet FP shape)
lang: python
file: rulelang_service.py
---
def evaluate(rule, context):
    evidence_packet_id = None
    try:
        packet = build_evidence_packet(rule, context)
        evidence_packet_id = packet["packet_id"]
    except Exception as exc:
        context.warnings.append(f"rule_evidence_packet_unavailable: {exc}")
    return {"evidence_packet_id": evidence_packet_id, "warnings": context.warnings}
